what_happened: The job was meant to let Athena accept newer Claude Code patch versions instead of stopping. It was rejected at the final verdict. One of 7 acceptance criteria was unmet: the criterion that `cargo test --workspace` and clippy pass and `cargo fmt --check` is clean. The `test` check failed. That is a check, not a criterion. It shows only CI log noise in the stored output. Two findings were listed. The blocker: the new D154 entry in docs/decisions.md (line 4222) says it "amends D03", and that link is not in the confirmed list in docs/decision-links.toml, so the workspace test suite fails. The major finding: behavior criterion 5 is unmet because its evidence must cite commands that ran (D43). The pin-relaxing code itself is not reported as faulty.
cause: Nothing makes the producer run the full workspace gate after its last edit and see it pass. Nothing tells it that a new decisions.md entry that links to another decision must also be registered in decision-links.toml. That rule is enforced only by a workspace test, so the producer found out at final verification and not while it could still fix it. Behavior evidence must cite commands that ran (D43), but nothing prompts the producer to run and record a command for each behavior criterion before it finishes. There is no cheap repair step for a mechanical defect like a missing link entry or missing evidence. Rejection is the only outcome. This is an inference, since the producer's report is not in the stored fields.
prevention: Before the producer may finish, Athena runs the cheap mechanical gate on the working copy: the decision-link consistency test (every "amends/supersedes Dxx" link in docs/decisions.md is in docs/decision-links.toml), fmt, clippy, and a scan that each behavior criterion has evidence citing a command that ran. If any of these fail, Athena returns the failure to the producer for a bounded repair round instead of passing the job to the verifier. The producer brief also says that a new decision entry with a link needs a matching decision-links.toml entry.
proposed_request: Make the producer stage run a pre-verification gate before a code job can be handed to the verifier. The gate runs the decision-link consistency test (every link in a new or changed docs/decisions.md entry must appear in docs/decision-links.toml), `cargo fmt --check`, and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets`. It also checks that every behavior criterion in the producer's report cites a command that actually ran (D43). If any of these fail, the failure text goes back to the producer for up to two repair rounds, and only then is the job handed to the verifier. Acceptance: a test with a fixture decision entry whose link is missing from decision-links.toml shows the gate fails and names the entry. A test with a behavior criterion that has no command evidence shows the gate fails. A test with clean input shows the gate passes. `cargo test --workspace`, clippy and `cargo fmt --check` pass, and the CHANGELOG has an entry.
